Name: Willy sells Wild Bait
Author: Nom0ri
Description:
[b][size=3]What exactly does this mod do:[/size][/b]
Simple mod that adds Wild Bait to Willy's shop, but only if you already know the recipe and you're friends with both Linus and Willy (default 8 hearts).

[b][size=3]Config:[/size][/b]
"Friendship Requirement" - configurable amount of Willy's and Linus' hearts before the bait shows in shop
